description: Unit tests for the RoundRobinSelector resource selector, verifying distribution, repetition handling, and duplicate scenarios within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: RoundRobinSelectorTests
classes.description: Test suite for the round-robin resource selector, including various selection behavior scenarios.

methods.name: NextSelectionWillGoThroughEveryResourceIfExistingSelectionEmptyTest
methods.description: Tests that the selector cycles through all resources when starting with an empty selection.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontGoInfinitelyTest
methods.description: Ensures that the selection process does not enter an infinite loop.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelectionsTest
methods.description: Verifies that the selector does not re-select already selected resources unnecessarily.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelectionsWithDuplicatesTest
methods.description: Checks that the selector handles duplicates appropriately without reselecting the same resource.
